note: Inputs from the unseen test split; predictions are computed live.

cases.title: Low-risk machine
cases.selection_rule: Normal test record nearest the median operating point, scored LOW

cases.title: High-risk machine
cases.selection_rule: Actual overstrain failure in the test split, scored HIGH, highest tool wear

cases.title: Borderline machine
cases.selection_rule: Test record with probability closest to (below) the HIGH threshold

cases.title: Invalid input
cases.selection_rule: Negative rotational speed and non-numeric torque; must be rejected by validation
cases.source: Constructed to test input validation (not a dataset record)

cases.title: Heat dissipation failure (actual)
cases.selection_rule: Actual HDF failure in the test split with the highest score

cases.title: Power failure (actual)
cases.selection_rule: Actual PWF failure in the test split with the highest score
